attributes.probed_form: ITEM 4: `permute_instruction_atoms` gained a keyword-only `where: str = ""` and became a thin wrapper that calls the renamed `_permute_instruction_atoms` inside `try/except ValueError` and re-raises as `ValueError(f"{where}: {exc}") from exc`, leaving `where=""` with the historical bare message. Labelling by WRAPPING rather than per raise site was deliberate: the frame has eight raise sites plus two helper calls that raise from their own frames, so a per-site edit can be missed by a refusal added later - and the helper case is covered too, which a per-site edit would not have been. Both call sites in `apply_patch` now pass the same shape its neighbouring aborts use: `f"{symbol.name}: permutation window +0x{relative_start:x}-0x{relative_end:x}"` and `f"{symbol.name}: post-recolor permutation window +0x..."`. ITEM 3: six `mechanism` strings in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json gained a CORRESPONDENCE JUSTIFICATION paragraph, spliced by locating each mechanism's full JSON-encoded value in the raw file and refusing unless it occurred EXACTLY ONCE - a tail-anchored edit is unsafe here because do_vibe and MBPsysSetDebugNode end with an identical boilerplate sentence. The splice script re-parsed the result and refused unless exactly the six intended `mechanism` fields differed; `git diff --numstat` reports 6 insertions / 6 deletions, i.e. no other lane's rule was reformatted.
attributes.residual: ITEM 3 VERDICT: all six rows are the benign uninitialised-data case, VERIFIED rather than assumed - every level-four word's TARGET-side symbol was resolved in config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt and every one lands in an uninitialised section: atree_handles = .bss:0x8023CFA0; lbl_80250E00 = .bss:0x80250E00 (do_enemies and fn_8004646C); lbl_802407B8 = .bss:0x802407B8 (do_vibe and InitControls); and for MBPsysSetDebugNode lbl_803451C0 = .sbss:0x803451C0, lbl_803451BC = .sbss:0x803451BC, lbl_80345190 = .sbss:0x80345190, lbl_802C9C48 = .bss:0x802C9C48. CU's stated falsifier - a level-four symbol resolving to an INITIALISED section - is measured ABSENT on all six. TWO CORRECTIONS to CU's reading, both measured: (a) MBPsysSetDebugNode's level-four set is ELEVEN words, not the ten CU reported; (b) it is the only one of the six where the correspondence is NAMED-to-NAMED across a naming-authority change rather than anonymous-section-symbol to named symbol - our object references its own uninitialised statics (`static s32 gNodeStackTop;` / `static s8 gNodeStackInit;` / `static s32 gNodeStackDirty;` at src/game/mb/mb_particle.c:2385-2387, therefore .sbss on our side too) while the target carries the split map's `lbl_` names for the same addresses, a bijection with addend delta 0 throughout. So the vacuity argument holds in BOTH directions there, which is a slightly stronger position than the other five rather than a weaker one. NOTHING FLAGGED as non-benign; no rule withdrawn.
